**How the hard constraints were met**

To guarantee verbatim quoting I parsed the transcript out of `brief.md` with a regex rather than retyping it, so each item's body is byte-exact against the source (including the trailing 「散会。」 on the 13:11 line — kept, not truncated, since the constraint forbids truncation). Every item carries a 【时间 · 说话人】 prefix.

Owner and deadline use stated deterministic rules with no guessing: owner is the speaker when the speaker is the one raising/owning the task, otherwise a third-party subject if one appeared explicitly (none did here); deadline is only lifted verbatim from the sentence — an absolute date like 「10月18日之前完成复检」 or an original relative phrase like 「周五前」 — and is never converted to a computed calendar date. The 13:08 resend has no time expression in its own sentence, so it is filled 「待定」.

**One judgment call worth flagging:** a line that could belong to two sections is assigned to exactly one, by the operative verb, with precedence 决议 > 待办 > 风险. That is why 13:08 (「有疑问…我们需要重新送检」) sits in 待办 rather than 风险 — its operative content is an action assignment, and 13:02 (「超差…需要修模」) likewise lands in 待办. If your convention is that any 疑虑/超差 signal should be logged under 风险与关注 instead, the split shifts and I can regenerate.

The generator is kept at `build_minutes.py` for reproducibility; re-running it regenerates both artifacts deterministically.
